subtitle.message: A little order for your chats

step1.message: Select the checkboxes beside your chats.

step2.message: Use the menu beside Chats to clear, invert or select all.

step3.message: Choose Delete, review and confirm once. Processing runs in the background.

scope.message: Select all and invert affect only chats currently loaded in the sidebar. Scroll to load more. Refreshing clears your selection.

privacy.message: Runs on ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen and Z.ai. Settings and your bookmarks (titles, short excerpts, tags, notes) stay in this browser; no credentials are saved and nothing is sent to the developer or third parties.

warning.message: Delete these $N$ chats on $SITE$ using its native deletion behavior. Chat Tidy cannot undo this operation.

failed.message: Completed $N$. The request failed; remaining selections were kept.

stopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Deletions already sent cannot be undone.

refresh.message: Refresh the website after installing or updating.

working.message: Deleting in the background. You can continue using the page.

apiError.message: Check your login or retry later. Refresh to verify uncertain results.

concurrencyHelp.message: Requests sent at the same time on every site (Claude sends up to 20 chats per request; Cowork tasks run one at a time). Default 5. Higher is faster but more likely to hit the site’s rate limit: short limits pause and resume automatically, long ones stop with a cooldown.

modeHint.message: When hidden, move to the left edge to reveal.

extensionDescription.message: Bulk-delete, archive or move AI chats, plus a chat outline, in-chat search, bookmarks and code tools.

archiveWarning.message: Archive these $N$ chats in ChatGPT. You can restore them from Settings → Data controls → Archived Chats.

archiveWorking.message: Archiving in the background. You can continue using the page.

archiveStopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Archived items can be restored on the website.

coworkArchiveWarning.message: Archive these $N$ Cowork tasks in Claude. Restore them using Claude’s archived task filter. Only Cowork tasks can be archived.

coworkArchiveOnly.message: Claude archive supports Cowork tasks only. Select tasks without ordinary chats.

grokShowAllHint.message: Show the complete Grok chat history in the sidebar.

grokLoadError.message: Could not load all chats. Turn Show all off and on to retry.

supportOpenError.message: Could not open the page. Please try again.

supportHint.message: This page stays open when you switch windows. If payment does not work here, use the Ko-fi website.

aboutTitle.message: Page enhancements for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen and Z.ai:

aboutChatgpt.message: ChatGPT: bulk delete, bulk archive, archive manager (restore / delete), move to a project or a new project.

aboutClaude.message: Claude: bulk delete, move to a group or a new group; Cowork tasks can be archived.

aboutGrok.message: Grok: bulk delete (including search results), show all history, hide or collapse Bots.

aboutQwen.message: Qwen: bulk delete, bulk archive, archive manager (restore / delete), move to a project or a new project.

moveHint.message: Choose an existing destination or create a new one. The website’s native move behavior is used; you can move chats again afterwards.

moveWorking.message: Moving in the background. You can continue using the page.

moveStopped.message: Stopped after $N$. Moved chats stay in the chosen destination.

destinationsEmpty.message: No destinations yet. Create a new one below.

destinationsError.message: Could not load the list. Check your login or retry later.

createError.message: Could not create it. Nothing was moved.

qwenArchiveWarning.message: Archive these $N$ chats in Qwen. You can restore them from Archived chats.

enhanceHint.message: Outline, search, bookmarks, code blocks and page layout

enhanceIntro.message: Everything here shows up on the chat page itself once you open a conversation.

outlineHint.message: Open any chat and a column of thin ticks appears at the right of the conversation, one per question you asked. Hover a tick to read the question, click to jump there; the icon on top opens the full list, where you can search this chat and bookmark answers.

codeToolsHint.message: In code blocks of answers: line numbers on the left, blocks over 24 lines fold up, hover a command line to copy just that line, and risky commands such as rm -rf / are marked in amber.

libraryHint.message: Chats and answers you bookmarked from the outline. Find them by tag or note, and open one to jump straight back to it.

layoutGroupHint.message: Changes how the chat page itself looks. Turn an option off to get the site’s own layout back.

chatWidthHint.message: Widens the conversation so long code and tables wrap less.

compactSidebarHint.message: Tighter rows in the chat list on the left, so more chats fit on screen.

hideClutterHint.message: Hides the disclaimer under the input box and upgrade banners.

focusModeHint.message: Hides the sidebar and top bar so only the chat remains; a button at the top right turns it off.

siteUnsupported.message: Not available on this site yet

libraryEmpty.message: Nothing saved yet. Open a chat, then bookmark it or one of its answers from the outline on the right.

outlineEmpty.message: Your questions in this chat will be listed here.

searchLoadedOnly.message: Searches messages loaded on this page

addTag.message: Add a tag, then press Enter

dangerGit.message: Discards Git history or local changes

dangerForkBomb.message: Fork bomb that can freeze the system

dangerSystem.message: Shuts down or kills system processes

step4.message: Open any chat for the outline, search and code tools; turn them on or off under Chat enhancements.
